title: Log_It_First_309b16a9
style: Electro-house with heavy synth-pop influences. Distorted, aggressive sawtooth bass synth syncopates with a four-on-the-floor kick drum and sharp, white-noise-heavy snare. Bright, staccato synth leads play rhythmic, repetitive riffs in the upper register. Processed male vocals feature heavy compression and slight saturation. High-frequency synth arpeggios and riser effects create tension before drops. Key of G minor, 128 BPM, 4/4 time.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted sawtooth bass, four-on-the-floor kick]
[staccato synth lead riff]
(Whoo!)

[Verse 1]
[processed male vocals]
Before you fix it, log it
Before you patch it, log it
Before the thread goes cold
Before the story's sold, log it
Timestamp on the moment
Evidence before the fix
Logs don't lie like people
Logs don't pull the tricks

[Chorus]
Log it first, log it first
Before you touch a single line
Log it first, log it first
The evidence is yours, not mine
Log it first, log it first
Log it first, log it first
Leave no verb behind

[Drop]
[heavy synth lead riff, aggressive bass]
(Whoo!)

[Verse 2]
Step two on a Tuesday
No one wants to own it
But the log already shows it
Can't delete, can't disown it
Human in the loop, always
Hub recorded, always
Audit trail complete, always
Log it first, always
Log it, log it, log it
Evidence before the burst
Log it, log it, log it
Get it over-versed

[Outro]
Log it first
Audit trail
For the section
